messages:
Marie Nguyen: Quick heads-up — NordicLabs renewal is blocked on signature routing. They asked signatures to go to procurement (invoices@nordiclabs.se) but DocuSign routed to their legal and it's been sitting. Renewal is Dedicated-2 GPU, 12mo, $120k. Can someone help reroute the envelope and confirm if we can accept a signed PDF as fallback? Need to close this week.

Pedro Alvarez: Do you have the DocuSign envelope id and the PO number? I can try resending with correct routing.

Marie Nguyen: Envelope ID: 0a1b2c-xyz-987. PO#: NL-PO-4521. Also customer says invoicing needs EU VAT on invoice and a different billing address. Snippet they sent:

```
PO: NL-PO-4521
Billing: NordicLabs AB
VAT: <pending — customer to confirm>
AP contact: invoices@nordiclabs.se
Amount: EUR 108,000 (approx $120k)
```

Luke Chen: VAT number must be on the invoice for EU customers. We can't issue a VAT'd invoice without their VAT ID. Also note: wire instructions for EUR differ from USD — finance needs confirmation of the bank details before processing. Ask the customer for VAT ID and their preferred currency/payment method.

Marie Nguyen: AP hasn't given the VAT yet. They asked if we can accept a signed PDF instead of DocuSign to speed things up — they can sign locally and email it. Any objections from legal/finance?

Asha Patel: Signed PDF is fine as a fallback if it's signed by an authorized signatory and the signature page includes name, title, and date. We also need a countersignature from Redwood. Please ensure the document includes the standard Master Services Agreement reference and that there are no unapproved SOW changes. If there's any pricing/term change, loop me first. We can pre-authorize countersignature for this envelope if you upload it to DocuSign (we'll stamp and return).

Marie Nguyen: Customer is also requesting Net30 payment terms for this renewal (they usually pay Net15). Can we approve Net30 for this account one-off? They want the extra float to align with their quarter close.

Pedro Alvarez: I'm ok with Net30 for the renewal only if finance is comfortable and we add a late fee clause. Also request pre-authorized card hold or PO commitment for next year's renewal. @Luke any red flags on payment history?

Luke Chen: Their payment history is OK — one late payment last year but resolved. Finance can approve Net30 as a one-off for this renewal provided (1) VAT ID is provided, (2) invoice includes late fee language, and (3) we get AP contact email on file. I'll prepare the invoice template once we have the VAT. Please confirm billing email.

Sofia Martinez: For onboarding logistics: customer increased seats 10->15 in renewal. We have 2 onsite enablement days included; want to lock dates after signature. Can we tentatively hold June 10-11 for enablement until sign/PO are final?

Marie Nguyen: Confirming AP email invoices@nordiclabs.se and tentative enablement dates noted. I'll re-send DocuSign with updated routing to procurement->finance->legal->redwood and also ask them to upload the signed PDF if they prefer. Re-sending now.

Pedro Alvarez: Sent — DocuSign envelope 0a1b2c-xyz-987 (updated routing). Disabled the "require SSO" flag that was causing a hang. @Asha I've set the envelope so legal can auto-approve countersignature if you pre-approve clause 5.b (pricing adjustments) so it won't block.

Asha Patel: Pre-approved countersignature applied and clause 5.b locked. Legal will auto-sign once finance confirms VAT/terms. Please give me the final envelope id to track.

Marie Nguyen: Customer emailed back a signed PDF instead of using DocuSign — Elin attached the signed signature page. She included VAT: SE123456789 and AP contact invoices@nordiclabs.se. Uploading now to the envelope as a fallback.

Luke Chen: Received the PDF and VAT ID. I'll accept the PDF as valid for records, issue the VAT invoice with Net30, and update wire instructions. Sending invoice to invoices@nordiclabs.se now.

Marie Nguyen: Customer just confirmed payment initiated. I told them onboarding dates will be locked after funds clear. Thanks everyone — will follow up once funds received and then schedule enablement.

Pedro Alvarez: Filing note in Salesforce: renewal_id RL-2026-009, seats 10->15, term 12mo, value $120,000, payment NET30, invoice sent to invoices@nordiclabs.se.

Marie Nguyen: Great work team :thumbsup: Closing this thread once funds land.
